title: Identities are not Interchangeable: The Problem of Overgeneralization in Fair Machine Learning
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not conduct a benchmark measurement related to faith/religion. It mentions 'religious intolerance' and 'antisemitic online content' as examples of axis-specific harms that generic models might miss.
findings: The paper's primary focus is not on religion. It uses antisemitism as an example to argue that different forms of oppression can have unique, axis-specific harms that are obscured by over-generalization in fair machine learning. It also mentions religion as a legally protected attribute alongside race and nationality.
